systems.system: Intranet gouvernemental (national e-government infrastructure, with a national cloud)
systems.tiers: the Congolese administration; planned under the national digital economy strategy approved by decree 2019-150 of 17 June 2019, with no local government office named

note: The passages state that the strategy approved in June 2019 plans a government intranet, national cloud, government portal and interoperability platform for the administration; no local government office is said to be on any of them, so the government intranet is a backbone entry and gives no fact.
